passage:
On their Kerala verandah, Seema held her father's phone, playing a farm game. A chat box slid open. "Hi little one, send me a photo. Don't tell your parents, it's our secret."
She did not understand, but the word secret made her tummy feel funny. She ran to the kitchen where Jomon was cutting banana leaves. "Appa, someone wants my photo!"
Jomon closed the chat and hugged her. "You did right to show me. It is not your fault. Anyone who asks you to keep secrets from Appa and Amma is not safe."
That evening he reported the account, turned off the chat and reminded her to always show him first.

qa.q: What did the message in the game ask Seema to send?
qa.a: It asked her to send a photo.

qa.q: Why did Seema run to her father?
qa.a: The word secret made her tummy feel funny, so she sensed something was wrong even though she did not fully understand the message.

qa.q: What should a child do when a stranger asks for a photo or a secret?
qa.a: Show a trusted adult straight away, as Seema did, because any request for secrets is a warning sign. 🤍

qa.q: How does Jomon see Seema's choice to show him?
qa.a: He sees it as the right thing to do, hugs her, tells her she did right and that it is not her fault, and reports the account that evening.

grounding: A game chat asks a young child for a photo and secrecy; the child shows a trusted adult, the wise rule.

passage:
"Ammi, the game has a chat box."
"Show me, Kamal."
"Someone called StarBoy says 'you play great. Send me a photo of you.' And 'don't tell your parents'."
Parveen put down the ladle and sat beside him. "Thank you for showing me. You did exactly the right thing."
"Is he my friend?"
"No, jaan. A real friend never asks you to keep secrets from Ammi. That's a warning sign."
She pressed block and report, and switched the chat off in the settings.
"Am I in trouble?"
"Never for showing me. Tonight we'll tell Abbu too."

qa.q: What did StarBoy ask Kamal to send?
qa.a: He asked Kamal to send a photo of himself.

qa.q: What was Kamal worried about when he asked if he was in trouble?
qa.a: He felt unsure and a bit afraid that showing Ammi the chat might get him scolded.

qa.q: What did Parveen do that protected Kamal?
qa.a: She thanked him, explained that asking for secrets is a warning sign, blocked and reported the stranger, switched the chat off and planned to tell Abbu that night.

qa.q: What would change if Kamal had kept the chat a secret?
qa.a: The stranger could keep pressuring him, and no trusted adult would know to protect him.

grounding: A stranger in a game chat asks a young boy for a photo and secrecy; he shows his mother, who ends the contact and praises him.

passage:
Note from Kamal Sir, computer-room teacher, to Sangeeta's parents.
Today, during the drawing game on the class tablet, a chat message popped up for Sangeeta: "Send me a picture of you. Don't tell your mummy." Sangeeta didn't understand it. She looked puzzled and brought the tablet to me. I told her, "You did the right thing showing me. Anyone who asks for secrets is not safe." I closed the chat, reported the account, turned off chat on all class tablets and told the head teacher. I'm writing so you can praise her tonight and talk about showing a grown-up.

qa.q: What did the chat message ask Sangeeta to do?
qa.a: It asked her to send a picture and not tell her mummy.

qa.q: How did Sangeeta feel when the message popped up?
qa.a: She felt puzzled and unsure, not understanding that it was unsafe.

qa.q: What did Kamal Sir do after Sangeeta showed him?
qa.a: He praised her, explained that asking for secrets is not safe, closed and reported the chat, turned off chat on class tablets, told the head teacher and wrote to her parents.

qa.q: How might Sangeeta's parents feel reading the note?
qa.a: They may feel shaken by the message but relieved and proud that Sangeeta showed a trusted adult.

grounding: A stranger asks a young girl for a picture and secrecy in a game chat; she shows her teacher, who ends the contact and tells her parents.
